action_items: (Low priority / informational) React logged a dev hydration warning on /partners: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. The warning is emitted by the Emergent dev tooling that wraps array-mapped children in a dev-only <span data-ve-dynamic='true' x-excluded='true'> for the CLIENT_RANGES <option> map (Partners.jsx line 253-257). It only appears in the dev React build and does not break the <select> (agency 'Clients today' selector works and submits correctly). No action required unless the dev tooling needs an exemption for <option> children.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py — PartnerCreate missing length guards on name upfront (handled after strip, fine). Position calculation uses count_documents with created_at < existing created_at — safe but will drift under concurrent inserts due to non-unique timestamps; add a unique index on email (currently non-unique index 'email' exists which is sufficient for the upsert).
Partners.jsx — email regex EMAIL_RE requires 2+ chars after the dot; backend EMAIL_RE accepts 1+. Minor mismatch (frontend stricter) — fine.
server.py — _rate_bucket is in-process and resets on reload; acceptable for single-worker dev but will not rate-limit in multi-worker production.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file at /app/backend/tests/test_partners.py (6 tests, all pass, ~1s).
